sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Technology / Software - Infrastructure · Indonesia. PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk provides and operates on-demand services in Indonesia and internationally. It offers Gojek on-demand services, including mobility, food delivery, and logistics through electronic media, software platforms, or applications to micro-entrepreneurs; GoTo Financial technology solutions, including consumer payments, lending, and merchant services; and e-commerce services.
